subject: Medford High School Security Protocols
overview: Medford High School announced new security protocols following a recent student stabbing and subsequent student walkout. The victim's mother expressed skepticism that the new measures will help.

items.title: New High School Security Protocols
items.summary: The superintendent announced new security protocols starting Tuesday, including bathroom monitoring and a limit of two students at a time, following a recent bathroom stabbing and student walkout.

items.title: Victim's Family Response
items.summary: The mother of 17-year-old stabbing victim Jordan Pineda stated that she does not believe the new security measures will help.
